note_fundamentals: App fundamentals come from the TradingView scanner (scripts/fundamentals.py), fundamental_currency_code=EGP for all 14. It converts USD statements to EGP: SPHT equity 2.70bn EGP vs USD 47.9M (2025) at about 56, SAIB equity 20.9bn EGP, NDRL 3.45bn EGP. So BVPS/EPS/revenue/profit beside a USD price are EGP unless the app converts them. TradingView's own P/B and P/E are currency-consistent. TRTO: statements are EGP, but TradingView treats its 0.059 price as USD (P/B 2.8); if TRTO is actually priced in EGP the true P/B is about 0.05. TRTO's price currency is the open question.
